headline: Mexican stock market advances at volatile start of session; Coca-Cola FEMSA shares stand out
summary: Local indexes rose in a volatile opening session, with Coca-Cola FEMSA among the notable movers. Investors were assessing economic data and new US tariff proposals.
why: The Mexican equity market reflects domestic growth, peso moves and trade policy with the United States, Mexico's largest trading partner.
why_moved: Investors were weighing Mexican economic data and new US tariff proposals during a volatile opening.
original_headline: Bolsa mexicana avanza en inicio de sesión volátil; destaca acción de Coca-Cola FEMSA
